content: You can pay with UPI, debit cards, credit cards, or cash on delivery.
Payment methods, checkout, cards, cash, UPI, payment options, and order billing are described generally.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days after inspection.
Exchanges are available within 14 days if the item is unused and in original packaging.
Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days; express shipping arrives in 1 to 2 business days.
If a parcel is delayed, check the courier tracking page and contact support after 48 hours.
To reset your password, click Forgot Password and follow the email link.
You can update your username from the profile settings page.
Dogs are loyal animals that enjoy walks, play, and training.
Cats are independent pets that like boxes, naps, and gentle routines.
Chocolate cake recipes use sugar, flour, butter, and frosting.
A sugar-free chocolate dessert uses cocoa, almond flour, and sweetener.
Residents can apply for a parking permit through the city portal.
Visitors may park in the guest lot for up to 24 hours with a temporary pass.
If a laptop battery swells, power it off and contact the manufacturer for replacement.
If the charger is loose, clean the port and test another USB-C cable.
To cancel a subscription, go to billing and choose cancel at the end of the cycle.
You can pause your membership for one billing cycle without losing your account.
Invoices include the GST number, line items, and total tax.
Receipts show purchase date, product name, and the final amount paid.
